description: Header file defining the SystemAudioPlayer class, which implements a plugin for the WPEFramework, providing APIs for System Audio Player (SAP) services, including notification handling and API methods.

classes.name: SystemAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces for SAP service API integration.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling remote connection notifications and system audio player events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the audio stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: PlayBuffer
methods.description: Plays audio buffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Checks if audio is currently playing.

methods.name: GetPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the current player session ID.

methods.name: dispatchJsonEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a JSON event with specified name and data.
